items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: The only man started that. Was Captain T.G. Low. He was the man that started that water cure... It was Captain Low. The great captain over there.

ctx.x: You know what they do? Like they captured a couple of Filipinas. They got a camp out there in the mountains somewhere. And if they didn't tell. What that camp was. They stick their head in the water. And let them half down. And then pull them out. And then he wouldn't tell. The people won't talk. They won't tell on one another. That is called the water cure. They stick them at. They take them. And they stick their head down in the water. Until they strangled. And then jerk them out. And if they tell them. They…
